# Experiment
Experiments are simple, unremarkable Sawians, often called cannon fodder. They're officially described as a mutated mix of a human, fox and rat.
While being a mix of multiple species, they are mostly canine - certain foods, like [color=red]coffee or chocolate will poison them[/color]. They can, however, eat raw meat without issue. Their claws make them adept at unarmed combat, and their eyes emit a permanent [color=yellow]bioluminescent glow[/color], helping see in the dark.
Experiments are rather cowardly and anxious in nature, fitting more in worker roles rather than leading. Some would call them mischievous.
